items.statement: All named neutral, radical, anion, and Fc/Fc+ states are optimized and validated with correct charge, multiplicity, stoichiometry, THF boundary, and a consistent one-electron reference convention.
items.expected: The submission documents minima validation and consistent thermochemical treatment for both dissociative reductions and the Fc/Fc+ reference.

items.statement: The dissociative reduction potential of 1a is reproduced.
The dissociative reduction potential of 1h is reproduced.
The two substrates are correctly ordered by reduction potential.
items.expected: 1h is 1.06 V more negative than 1a; 1a is easier to reduce within this model.
